calls.statement:
SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys,
 sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) AS max_join, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_valid_from,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS rows_oct3,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS stg_rows_oct3

calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member o WHERE o.member_id = m.member_id AND o.member_key <> m.member_key)) AS multi_version,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND m.member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03')) AS not_in_stg,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND valid_from <> join_date) AS valid_from_differs,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date) > 1)) AS ids_with_multiple_join_dates
